verdict.rationale: The evidence describes only human web-portal filing: dashboards, online document upload, FranceConnect+ login, card or delegated payment, and qualified e-signatures. Nothing documents a system-to-system filing channel, system accounts, transmitter programs, or a published enrollment path for software. The high-volume line (docs-12) refers to a payment modality, not a machine channel. The keyless recherche-entreprises API (probe-2) is a separate read-only state data service and does not let software transact with the Guichet unique.
